data.key: Mantis Zealot ~ Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.description: Mantis zealots are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, as well as with the sawtooth sabre, and with light armor. They are not proficient with shields.
